title: The "store" for me almost looks like a prop warehouse that we are buying things from.
content: In the store, there is food, but in most the other sections it's just shelves and shelves of things I think of as "junk" or I think who tf would want to buy 99% of the things in the mallworld store?! I even see the bigger shelves that start to have other things like scooters, outdoor appliances, like the outdoor section of a walmart but even more items and it was dark and dingy. I saw a video showing the inside of the prop warehouse and realized it looks *way* closer to mallworld stores i go into rather than normal grocery stores like a walmart.
